author: Kamil Mete Yalcinkaya
description: Detects the recognisable one-liners that redirect a shell over a network socket, covering the bash /dev/tcp form, netcat with an execution flag, and the Python socket-to-pty pattern.
false_positives: Authorised penetration tests and red-team exercises. Correlate with the engagement window.
name: Interactive Reverse Shell Invocation
note: Investigation fields: process.command_line, process.parent.name, destination.ip, destination.port, user.name
query: ((process.command_line:*\/dev\/tcp\/* OR process.command_line:*\/dev\/udp\/*) OR process.command_line:/.*\bn(c|cat|etcat)\b.*\s-[a-zA-Z]*e\b.*/ OR ((process.command_line:*socket* AND process.command_line:*subprocess*) AND (process.command_line:*pty.spawn* OR process.command_line:*dup2*)))
